adapter: AdapterInfo { name: "AMD Radeon 760M Graphics (RADV PHOENIX)", vendor: 4098, device: 5567, device_type: IntegratedGpu, driver: "radv", driver_info: "Mesa 25.2.8-0ubuntu0.24.04.2", backend: Vulkan }

shadow_inspector.scope: monotonic seconds since viewer visual start; stream reason/LOD changes and actual GPU caster membership; does not infer shadow texel visibility

process_memory.scope: Linux whole-process RSS and high-water RSS including startup and active workers; not GPU allocation accounting or a hard memory bound

adaptive.preparation_stage_note: CPU stage sums; canonical source query costs are included in caller stages, not exclusive source timings

route_height_policy: FBM proxy routes clamp to canonical surface +10m; hybrid routes clamp +1.7m; freefly unconstrained

ground_assembly_cache.scope: process-shared native ground assembly; conservative accounting excludes worker-held Arcs

jobs.scope: cumulative overlapping worker wall time; order placement,tree,ground; assembly includes growth/cache lookups and native-cell assembly

naadf_gpu_pass.scope: primary exact visibility and its direct shadows; includes render pass setup and any active traversal compute prepass; mesh receiver NAADF shadow queries are in raster spans

draw_encode_cpu_measured.scope: Gpu::draw wall time: queue writes, optional summary dispatch encoding, render pass begin/end, bundle replay or direct draw encoding; excludes adaptive.prepare, command finish/submit, present, atmosphere and UI
draw_encode_cpu_measured.sample_policy: preceding presented draw paired with the next accepted frame interval after route start and warmup; bounded rolling 10000 samples
draw_encode_cpu_measured.gpu_scope: gpu_render_pass is a separately counted asynchronous terrain-pass subset; not whole-frame GPU time

frame_observations.scope: last presented frames, including startup/warmup; prepare_ms is main-thread wall time before surface acquisition; GPU timestamps are separate asynchronous samples

gpu_full_render.scope: GPU command span: shadows, opaque terrain and plants, atmosphere, UI; excludes prior uploads, CPU preparation and presentation; asynchronous unpaired timestamps

vegetation_gpu_timing.scope: asynchronous vegetation color and plant-only shadow spans; excludes terrain and CPU generation
